notes: Benchmark period is 2017-2022 (6 full calendar years); forcing runs through 2023-01-01 00:00 as the boundary instant ecLand needs to drive the last timestep (see ../ecland-portal README's NSTOP discussion). Physiography/init (surfclim/surfinit, which do not depend on end_date) staged from portal job 20260904T120600_Ld-001 -- a physiography-only rerun -- relabelled from its 2017-2026 placeholder via 'stage_portal_job.sh --years 2017-2022'. Forcing is sourced as daily 'oper' GRIB tarballs from ECFS via scripts/get_forcing_ecfs.sh -- full 2017-2022 raw GRIB (2192 days, 4.2 TB) downloaded 2026-09-04/05. Point-extracted per year (2017-2022, 5 jobs in parallel for 2018-2022) then joined into one file with scripts/merge_yearly_forcing.py (52585 hourly steps, no gaps/NaNs). Validated: 10-day smoke test, a full-year (2017) spin-up check with NLOOP=8 (end-of-year FLake state converges within 2-3 loops, loop7->8 delta <0.0006 K), AND a full 2017-2022 single-pass run (~2 min wall clock, ecland-master-dp) -- AvgSurfT stays in [253,295]K throughout, ~23% of hours under ice, stable year-to-year variability, no drift. That run was a COLD START (no spin-up loop) -- a scored benchmark should prepend a spin-up loop over 2017 first, per the convergence check. MUST use /perm/pad/ecland/build/bin/ecland-master-dp, not /perm/pad/ecland-build/bin/ecland-master -- see README Known issues, the latter silently freezes lake state to a constant default with no error.
